incidents.name: Idols NFT self-transfer reward double-credit
incidents.notes: IdolMain paid out accrued stETH rewards to both the sender and the receiver on every NFT transfer, so safeTransferFrom(self, self, tokenId) called in a loop from a constructor (which also bypasses the Address.isContract() guard) collected rewardPerGod repeatedly without ever giving up the token.

sources.ref: onchain review: IdolMain 0x439cac149B935AE1D726569800972E1669d17094 (verified) created 2022-03-02T00:24:23Z by 0x1a898355c4939e1e4b15330d4da1fc028a8dad66, not the attack-tx sender 0xe546480138d50bb841b204691c39cc514858d101; no EIP-1967 events, so the code was 1049.7 days old. The PoC notes the loop was repeated across 15 transactions between blocks 21624128 and 21626362; 97 stETH at a January 2025 ETH price near $3,200 is roughly $310k. Loss converted at the incident timestamp: 97 stETH x $3,202.66 (DefiLlama historical ETH price) = $310,658.
